svg.text: Pebble — tabletop (canonical start, Unequal Routes map)
CONCEPT SKETCH · vector illustration of design intent · not a model render · not CAD evidence
Ivory sits on the rank-1 side · A1 ivory home · J10 charcoal home · numbers = stack height
Inset: pending glyph beside an occupying T3 piece
(SPEC §5.2: real units may stop on a pending square)
Worst case: metal glyph beside a T3 with four 4-high stacks.
It overhangs the tile edge by 47.71 mm² but touches nothing.
The symbol reads upright from its owner's seat;
that orientation marks whose summon it is.
